mapper.sql: (SELECT `code`, MAX(`pct_chg`) AS `pct_chg`, MAX(`amount`) AS `amount`, MAX(`volume`) AS `volume`, MAX(`turnover`) AS `turnover`, MAX(`amplitude`) AS `amplitude`, MAX(`tradestatus`) AS `tradestatus`, MAX(`is_st`) AS `is_st` FROM `stock_daily_all` WHERE `trade_date` = #{tradeDate} GROUP BY `code`) d
AND COALESCE(d.`adjustflag`, -1) = ( SELECT COALESCE(MIN(d2.`adjustflag`), -1) FROM `stock_daily_all` d2 WHERE d2.`code` = d.`code` AND d2.`trade_date` = d.`trade_date`)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT `trade_date` FROM `stock_daily_all` ORDER BY `trade_date` DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT #{tradeDate} AS `tradeDate`, COUNT(*) AS `totalStocks`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`pct_chg` > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `upCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`pct_chg` < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `downCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`pct_chg` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `flatCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`pct_chg` >= 9.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `limitUpCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`pct_chg` <= -9.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `limitDownCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`tradestatus` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `suspendedCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`is_st` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `stCount`, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`pct_chg` > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100, 2),0) AS `upRatio`, COALESCE(SUM(d.`volume`),0) AS `totalVolume`, COALESCE(SUM(d.`amount`),0) AS `totalAmount`, COALESCE(AVG(d.`pct_chg`),0) AS `avgPctChg`, COALESCE(AVG(d.`turnover`),0) AS `avgTurnover` FROM
SELECT FLOOR(d.`pct_chg`) AS `bucket`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM WHERE d.`pct_chg` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FLOOR(d.`pct_chg`)

SELECT i.`code` AS `code`, i.`name` AS `name`, i.`board` AS `board`, i.`industry` AS `industry`, d.`trade_date` AS `tradeDate`, d.`open` AS `open`, d.`high` AS `high`, d.`low` AS `low`, d.`close` AS `close`, d.`preclose` AS `preclose`, d.`pct_chg` AS `pctChg`, d.`chg_amt` AS `chgAmt`, d.`volume` AS `volume`, d.`amount` AS `amount`, d.`turnover` AS `turnover`, d.`amplitude` AS `amplitude`, d.`pe_ttm` AS `peTtm`, d.`pb_mrq` AS `pbMrq`, d.`is_st` AS `isSt`, d.`tradestatus` AS `tradeStatus` FROM `stock_daily_all` d LEFT JOIN `stock_info` i ON i.`code` = d.`code` WHERE d.`trade_date` = #{tradeDate} AND d.`pct_chg` IS NOT NULL
AND i.`board` = #{board} AND (d.`is_st` IS NULL OR d.`is_st` = 0) ORDER BY
d.`pct_chg` ASC d.`amount` DESC d.`volume` DESC d.`turnover` DESC d.`amplitude` DESC d.`pe_ttm` ASC d.`pb_mrq` ASC d.`pct_chg` DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.`industry`i.`board` AS `name`, COUNT(*) AS `stockCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`pct_chg` > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `upCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`pct_chg` < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `downCount`, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.`pct_chg` > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100,2),0) AS `upRatio`, COALESCE(AVG(d.`pct_chg`),0) AS `avgPctChg`, COALESCE(SUM(d.`amount`),0) AS `totalAmount`, COALESCE(AVG(d.`turnover`),0) AS `avgTurnover` FROM JOIN `stock_info` i ON i.`code` = d.`code` WHERE i.`industry`i.`board` IS NOT NULL AND i.`industry`i.`board` <> '' GROUP BY i.`industry`i.`board` ORDER BY `avgPctChg` DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT `trade_date` AS `tradeDate`, COUNT(*) AS `stockCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN `pct_chg` > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `upCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN `pct_chg` < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `downCount`, COALESCE(SUM(`amount`),0) AS `totalAmount`, COALESCE(AVG(`pct_chg`),0) AS `avgPctChg` FROM ( SELECT `trade_date`, `code`, MAX(`pct_chg`) AS `pct_chg`, MAX(`amount`) AS `amount` FROM `stock_daily_all` WHERE `trade_date` BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY `trade_date`, `code` ) t GROUP BY `trade_date` ORDER BY `trade_date` ASC
